description.high-school: The students will be welcomed at the Institute of Energy and Environment (IEE-USP) by undergraduate students from the Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science at IME-USP. After a talk given by USP undergraduate students, they will walk to the School of Architecture, Urbanism and Design (FAU-USP), where they will take part in the remaining scheduled activities.
